programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.title: Road To Dharma

Ken, the newbie to spirituality isn’t so on board and his passenger Tiffany a mom with a 3 year-old, fears losing her life.

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Badrinath – Reverberating with thousands of years of yogic wisdom… But Jeff won’t even wear a helmet. You try and talk to him, he won’t listen to me, says Jen. programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: En su camino, Chip y sus amigos encuentran una isla rodeada por un gran lago de ácido, bajo la constante amenaza de erupción de un volcán. En la isla viven átomos de lantánidos que, según la leyenda, esperan la llegada de un «elegido» que les proporcione el ácido que les impide abandonar la isla. Chip, gracias a su libro, descubre que el volcán emitió una base que, al mezclarse con el ácido, puede neutralizar el peligroso lago y convertirlo en una agradable extensión de agua salada.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: En medio de un desierto abrasador, Chip y los átomos se encontraron con un átomo de tungsteno que les brindó refugio bajo un edificio piramidal que, hasta hacía poco, contaba con un ingenioso sistema de refrigeración por el que circulaba una corriente de amoníaco en su sótano. Pero ahora, el Dr. No ha desviado el flujo de amoníaco para su propio beneficio. Chip descubre el punto donde se desvía el amoníaco y construye una presa que lo devuelve a su curso normal.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Dork Hunters and The Pirates of Tortuga Island
programme.desc: The Dork Hunters visit tropical Tortuga Island on their summer vacation, unaware that the Dork Commander and his second-in-command are at the same resort in search of a buried treasure chest full of micro-galaxies

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

Finita trata de que Fabián le envíe a Wilker a Briggite para tomar medidas de una persiana. Fabián le dice que sino puede ir Wilker va él. Pero Finita lo convence de que mande a Wilker. programme.desc: Pascuita hace creer a Matilde que Monchito está muy apasionado por ella.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.desc: Inés está discutiendo con Daniela y la amenaza que no vuelva a meterse con su hermana. Que no sea egoísta. Que Luis Guillermo nunca la quiso que lo deje tranquilo hacer su vida con Betania. Daniela le dice que nunca va a dejar que Luis Guillermo sea de otra. Marisela y Alfredo se van a despedir de Flavia y Patricia y a dar las gracias por todo lo que habían hecho por ellos. Al mismo tiempo Michelle y Diego Andrés están preparando maletas para el viaje a la hacienda. Berta se presenta en la casa de los Nuñez aprovechando que no hay nadie sino Marta. Habla con Emperatriz, le monta un teatro con lágrimas y todo y Emperatriz se va con Berta para la casa de los Malavé. Una vez más Berta se sale con la suya.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Adolfo llega de sus vacaciones en Europa y trae nuevas ideas para la empresa y las expone en la junta directiva. María Lucía le pregunta a Felipe sobre ciertas cartas o documentos en los cuales consta que Virginia no fue la responsable del asesinato. Irene es atacada verbalmente por una de las empleadas de la empresa delante de todo el personal y esta no sabe que decirle. Solo la quiere ayudar pero la empleada no se deja. Irene y Leonardo deciden que Trinidad debería pasar una temporada en su casa y para ello le encargan a Virginia de que la convenza. Trinidad está furiosa porque Sandra le dijo que Virginia era una asesina. Alejandra le pide a una amiga que se haga pasar por enfermera que deberá cuidar a Trinidad y lo único que espera es obtener información que le convenga.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol, a instancias de Maricielo, decide avanzar con la investigaci n sobre el asesinato de sus supuestos padres. Alicia le confiesa a Carlos que gusta de l. Don Eloy le acerca a Columba un documento que prueba que Jos Domingo malvers fondos que retir del banco. Cuando Cristo Jos pide ir a una universidad privada y el padre se lo niega, Columba lo enfrenta con la revelaci n de que conoce sus secretos financieros. Maricielo conmina a Carlos a que le presente a la doctora Beatriz.

programme.desc: It’s a battle of the sexes for the highest pain threshold. Country girl Cas celebrates her new found confidence, while Rachel mourns her past. A risky tatt for Nan and patience wears thin as the studio is invaded by ‘blokes.’

programme.title: Tattoo Tales
programme.desc: Excitement is in the air with a VIP client. Julie curates her life on her skin, while Shaun helps Sandy through a crippling struggle. It’s a celebration of life, with clients and staff all weighing in.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Cheyne and Danielle live with a small menagerie, and want to add a dog to their blossoming family. With a sheep, and with four chickens running around in the backyard Dr. Lisa will need to keep her wits about her to find the right fit.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Career woman Kylie lives in an inner city apartment but wants some four legged company. Kylie has places to walk a new friend, but will Dr. Lisa give her the OK to have a dog in a small apartment? How do dogs cope in such an environment?

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Jess, has wanted a dog for as long as she can remember, but living with her parents and renting has thrown up several ‘road blocks’. Jess wants a dog that her mum will cope with, and that will get along with her other passion….her horses.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Julien & Nicolette have three daughters, and Keira, 4, has an irrational fear of dogs. Dr. Lisa advises that the best thing to do might be to get a dog. Will the cure work and what special issues do three young girls put in her way?

programme.desc: It happens that grown-up people have their own fears! For example, one grandmother was very afraid not to please her grandson. Whatever she cooked- nothing was good enough for him. Much fear he had suffered until his grandmother came back! This terrible trick taught him a worthy lesson so nevertheless he was cranky ever after and ate with a terrible appetite!

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it’s her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf’s tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf’s tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat’s voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

Despite Tsar’s insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.
